places.name: Apartheid Museum
places.ai_summary: A powerful museum documenting South Africa's apartheid history through multimedia exhibits, photographs, and personal stories, offering deep insights into the country's past.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Good Friday and Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Allow extra time to fully absorb the exhibits and emotional impact.
places.address: Northern Parkway & Gold Reef Road, Ormonde, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Constitution Hill
places.ai_summary: A former prison complex now home to South Africa's Constitutional Court, offering guided tours through its historic prison cells and exhibitions on human rights.
places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to learn about the site's fascinating history.
places.address: 11 Kotze Street, Braamfontein, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Soweto Township Tour
places.ai_summary: An immersive cultural experience exploring South Africa's largest township, including visits to Vilakazi Street, where both Nelson Mandela and Desmond Tutu once lived.
places.place_tip: Book with a reputable tour company and bring cash for local purchases.
places.address: Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Mandela House Museum
places.ai_summary: The former home of Nelson Mandela on Vilakazi Street in Soweto, now a museum showcasing his personal belongings and documenting his life during apartheid.
places.place_tip: Combine with a Soweto tour for a comprehensive experience.
places.address: 8115 Vilakazi Street, Orlando West, Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Gold Reef City Theme Park
places.ai_summary: A theme park built on an old gold mine, offering thrilling rides, live entertainment, and a glimpse into Johannesburg's gold mining heritage.
places.place_tip: Visit on weekdays to avoid long queues for rides.
places.address: Northern Parkway & Data Crescent, Ormonde, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Maboneng Precinct
places.ai_summary: A vibrant urban neighborhood featuring art galleries, boutique shops, restaurants, and the famous Market on Main, showcasing Johannesburg's creative renaissance.

opening_hours.notes: Market on Main operates on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Visit on Sunday for the Market on Main food and craft market.
places.address: Kruger Street, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Cradle of Humankind (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring fossil sites and caves where some of the oldest hominid fossils were discovered, including the famous Sterkfontein Caves.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the cave tours and exhibitions.
places.address: Cradle of Humankind, Gauteng, South Africa

places.name: Lion & Safari Park
places.ai_summary: A wildlife park offering game drives, lion interactions, and walking tours where visitors can see lions, cheetahs, wild dogs, and other African animals.
places.place_tip: Book the lion cub interaction experience for an unforgettable encounter.
places.address: R512, Broederstroom, Hartbeespoort, South Africa

places.name: Walter Sisulu National Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A beautiful botanical garden featuring indigenous plants, walking trails, picnic spots, and a stunning waterfall, home to breeding pairs of Verreaux's Eagles.

opening_hours.notes: Closes at 7 PM in summer months.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic basket and enjoy lunch by the waterfall.
places.address: Malcom Road, Poortview, Roodepoort, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.place_tip: Take a photo with the iconic Mandela statue in the square.

places.ai_summary: South Africa's largest art gallery, housing an extensive collection of traditional and contemporary African art, European masterpieces, and rotating exhibitions.
places.place_tip: Check the website for current exhibitions and special events.

places.ai_summary: A popular Saturday food and craft market in Braamfontein, offering artisanal foods, live music, local crafts, and a vibrant atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds and get the best food selections.
places.address: 73 Juta Street, Braamfontein, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Hector Pieterson Museum
places.ai_summary: A moving memorial museum dedicated to Hector Pieterson and the 1976 Soweto Uprising, documenting the student protests against apartheid education policies.
places.place_tip: Combine with a Soweto tour for a comprehensive historical experience.
places.address: 8287 Khumalo Road, Orlando West, Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Orlando Towers Adventure Site
places.ai_summary: A former power station transformed into an adventure hub, offering bungee jumping, abseiling, zip-lining, and the Big Swing between two iconic cooling towers.
places.place_tip: Book in advance and wear comfortable clothing for adventure activities.
places.address: Chris Hani Road, Orlando, Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Montecasino Entertainment Complex
places.ai_summary: An Italian-themed entertainment complex featuring a casino, theaters, restaurants, bars, and the Montecasino Bird Gardens with exotic bird species.
places.place_tip: Check the theater schedule for live shows and performances.
places.address: Montecasino Boulevard, Fourways, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Johannesburg Zoo
places.ai_summary: One of South Africa's premier zoos, home to over 2,000 animals representing more than 320 species, including lions, elephants, and rare white tigers.
places.place_tip: Visit during feeding times for the most active animal behavior.
places.address: Jan Smuts Avenue, Parkview, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Rosebank Sunday Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant outdoor market held every Sunday, featuring African art, crafts, jewelry, clothing, and live music in the heart of Rosebank.
places.place_tip: Bring cash for purchases and haggle for better prices on crafts.
places.address: Cradock Avenue, Rosebank, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Melville Koppies Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: A pristine urban nature reserve offering hiking trails through rocky ridges, indigenous vegetation, and Stone Age archaeological sites with panoramic city views.

opening_hours.notes: Open for guided tours on Wed, Thu, Sun.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy hiking shoes and bring water for the trails.
places.address: Judith Road, Melville, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.name: Newtown Cultural Precinct
places.ai_summary: A revitalized cultural hub featuring the Market Theatre, Museum Africa, and numerous galleries, celebrating Johannesburg's diverse arts and heritage scene.
places.place_tip: Check the Market Theatre schedule for live performances and shows.
places.address: Newtown, Johannesburg, South Africa

places.ai_summary: An interactive museum exploring the history of beer brewing in South Africa, featuring exhibits, tastings, and tours of the South African Breweries heritage.
places.place_tip: Book the tasting tour to sample various local beers.
